description: This file defines the WebAppConfigurationException class, which is a custom exception used in the web application framework of Apache OFBiz. It extends GeneralException and is used to handle configuration-related errors specific to web application settings.

classes.name: WebAppConfigurationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for web application configuration errors, extending GeneralException.
